claim_checks.source: General biset definition pp. 7-8; Theorems 1.1/1.3 pp. 2-3; portrait/entropy uses p. 19 and pp. 26,29-32
claim_checks.independent_reason: For G=F2, take B={0,1}xG with regular right and trivial left actions. These commute, the right action is free and has two orbits, all positive sections are identity and the nucleus is {1}. The limit is binary Cantor space; d_s=e^(-sL) gives mutually quasisymmetric Ahlfors-regular metrics of dimension log(2)/s, hence conformal dimension zero, and p_c=0. The symmetric finitely supported generating walk has a nonconstant bounded harmonic branch-hitting probability, f(1)=1/4 and f(a)=3/4; its explicit geometric formulas satisfy the mean-value relation.
claim_checks.counterevidence_and_impact: The introductory faithful-tree viewpoint, explicit later faithful hypotheses and faithful IMG quotient identify the intended setting. They do not remove the general biset definition's missing faithfulness assumption. Entropy portraits recover only the faithful quotient, which is trivial here, while the original group is non-Liouville.
claim_checks.correction_scope: Retain Major for the printed broad core guarantee. Require faithfulness or state the conclusion for the faithful quotient; do not refute the intended faithful/IMG cases.

claim_checks.independent_reason: For the faithful binary adding machine, p_c=1. Pull the circle metric back by h(x)=1/(1-log_2 x) on 0<x<=1/2 and h=x above. This is isometric to the ordinary circle and therefore 1-Ahlfors regular. At level n a single allowed displacement from zero to 2^(-n) has length 1/(n+1), so with p=beta=2 one energy term decays polynomially and cannot be bounded uniformly by C lambda^n.
claim_checks.counterevidence_and_impact: The metric is outside the visual quasiconformal gauge, exactly the missing hypothesis needed for the cited proposition. The downstream theorem can choose a metric within that gauge.
claim_checks.correction_scope: Retain Minor and add the quasiconformal-gauge hypothesis to the auxiliary assertion.

claim_checks.independent_reason: Changing the adding-machine basepoint shifts the level-n cyclic interval of words by one step, so exact plate-set equality fails at every n>=3. Uniform discrepancy below 1/12 instead gives containment in closed radius-5/12 plates. These remain disjoint for centers at distance at least one, and capacity monotonicity yields the required upper bound.
claim_checks.correction_scope: Retain the supplied repair, without an additional core-failure claim.
